27595.overview:
The lone crow has finally made a friend. However, his friend is a migratory bird from the south, who must leave for the south at the end of the summer. At the end of the summer, the friend says, "I'll come back when it's full of flowers," and then he leaves.

This game was born from the TV Asahi's "D's Garage 21" creator discovery program, "The Bird that Sows Seeds". The player must fill the town and fields with flowers so that the main character's friend, a raven, can return home quickly. You must guide the crow's seeds so that water will be distributed to the flowers and collect the droplets of water to kill the pests and fill the field with flowers.

A two player mode is available via the Communication Cable.

27610.overview:
A simple collection of two classic puzzle games, Gomoku Narabe & Reversi/Othello.

Gomoku Narabe is a ancient Japanese game the title of which means "five stones in a row". The goal of the game is to place five tokens of your color (white or black) in a row. Of course your opponent will be trying to block you. The game ends when a player achieves tis penta-worthy task. The board is 14 x 14.

Reversi is a game commonly known under the name that it is marketed by Pressman, Othello. In reversi ones goal is to flip the opponents tiles (white or black) by surrounding the opposing token(s) on either end with your own. The board is 8x8.

A challenge mode approaches! You can battle your way through ranks of board game master beginning with a horrid smiling goblin and moving up to a mysterious old guru.

Two players can play the game through the Communication Cable.

27672.overview:
Tanjou Debut puts the player into the role of a music company agent, who has to work with three potential stars of entertainment: three young girls named Aki, Kumi, and Saori. In the beginning of the game, the player views the statistics of each girl and her personality description. Afterwards, the training begins. Most of the game is spent planning schedules for the girls. Practicing music skills, working, having a vacation - everything has an influence on the girls' statistics. It is important to keep the girls happy and reduce their stress; at the same time, having vacations without practicing will diminish their professional skill.

After a period of training, the player chooses which specific branch he/she wants the girls to compete in: commercial photos (model), staging a musical, performing a pop concert, making a movie, etc. Depending on the player's preparations and previous training, the girls will get higher or lower ratings. The player-controlled group competes against other agencies in a league, and results are shown after each major event.

27673.overview:
Tarepanda no Gunpey is a Gunpey style puzzler which has the modes of Gunpey EX with an additional Tarepanda story mode. 

The game includes classic Gunpey, endless Gunpey, a timed line removal mode, and a mode where the player must clear all lines at once. Two players can also link up to challenge each other and exchange high-scores. 

A story mode is also included. Tarepanda discovers the existence of other lazy pandas all around the world; wondering what other floppy pandas are like Tare rolls off in search of them.

Each panda wears headgear associated with its homeland, top hat for Britain, turban for India, etc. When our hero is about to reach the new lazy panda something gets in the way, usually an incline too large to roll over. By finishing a certain number of lines you'll give your stymied panda the energy to jump the obstacle. 

In the story mode a number of novel hazards are presented. Your lines may flip angles, or parts of the screen may be entirely blocked out.

27674.overview:
Tekken Card Challenge is a Tekken video game released for the WonderSwan. It uses the characters from Tekken 3, including an exclusive playable character to the game, Crow, which was previously appeared as NPCs in the original.

Tekken Card Challenge utilizes a system similar to its Pokémon counterpart. Two opponents are to fight at a time, with various cards for different maneuvers and a 100 point HP total for damage accumulation. The player begins with a hand of four cards, drawing more as the duel proceeds. The battle system is similar to Yu-Gi-Oh! in that the three types of cards perform in a rock, paper, and scissors pattern. Attack cards are played against each other to compare values with the loser being discarded and deducting HP, an attack card played against a defense nullifies each other (except in the case of a counter), and two block cards cancel each other out. There is also a minor system of air juggling, which can be quite damaging given the correct order of cards.

Tekken Card Challenge also provides the player with a variety of game modes. There is a link mode via Communication Cable to connect two WonderSwans for a fight, 1-player battle, and (the main mode) Adventure, which allows the player to unlock more characters and duel opponents. In adventure mode, the player is given movement of a character sprite in a full environment taken place on a 15 x 15 square grid to traverse. The point of each stage is to defeat each "duelist" given limited number of steps and gain entrance to the exit.

27675.overview: The first genre of mobile games, the first in the “Novel Theater” series. With TERRORS that makes the most of Wonderswan's images and sounds, you can enjoy five stories about the theme of fear. Read through the text that appears on the screen, and select an option that appears everywhere. The story diverges and the ending changes. The branch by teller point that appears when the hero feels fear will lead to new fear.

27676.overview:
The old-fashioned black-and-white anime version (original version) of Tetsujin 28 will be revived on the WonderSwan monochrome screen!

There is no need to explain the story now, but the boy detective Shotaro Kanada manipulates the invincible robot Tetsujin 28 to solve various difficult and mysterious cases. Although the story part progresses as a normal adventure game, it shifts to a command input type battle in the battle scene. During battle, the game requires quick and accurate command input and accurate judgment.

And at the end of the game, the iron man's serious secret seems to be revealed...!?

27677.overview:
Popular animation Time Bokan Series aired in the 50s. Three of the bad trio who have consistently worked as villains are back! PlayStation has released two Time Bokan Series games as shooters so far, but this time RPG is the name of the game. RPG makes it possible to enjoy the new story in the nostalgic atmosphere of all seven TV series.

In this game, three characters (Dronjo, Tonsler and Boyakki) appear in the most popular work Yatterman in the Time Bokan Series. Doronjo and others will continue to travel while collecting the funds at Inchiki Commerce to create bad mechanics and fighting with good mechanics in order to execute the orders received from the god of thieves, Dokurobei.

27678.overview:
Despite being a card battle, Tokyo Majin Gakuen: Fujin Gakuen: Fujin Spell Sealoku has a large 64M ROM, beautiful graphics and high quality sound. Based on the world of Tokyo Majin Gakuen: Kenpucho, which was released on the PlayStation, Fuju Houroku consists of a newly drawn scenario.

The adventure part features an emotion input system that allows players to input their emotions in eight different ways, while the card generation system, which creates more than 120,000 different cards, is used in the card battles. The game also incorporates the concepts of yin and yang and the five elements of shikigami and hōjutsu, and features more than 150 characters from "~Kenpūcho", the fan disc "~Oboro Kitan", and the CD drama "~Demajin", giving this game a full range of Tokyo Majin Gakuen flavors.

27680.overview: Turntablist: DJ Battle is a music game, where you go head-to-head against computer controlled DJ and battle it out with your turntable by creating beats and using samples.

31927.overview: Dr. Ken Chen, an authority on Go thinking routines and the winner of the "International Go Congress" and many other titles in various Go software competitions, created a powerful and fast thinking engine for Taikyoku Igo: Heisei Kiin, which has an established reputation for its high speed, and you can choose from four different computer levels. From beginners to advanced players, all levels of players can play at their own level. In addition, there is a "Basic Introduction" for beginners to help them learn the basics of Go in an easy way. In addition, there are two types of Go boards, the 'Nine-Joint Board' and the 'Thirteen-Joint Board'.

127354.overview:
Previous Trump Collection title included four different games: Grand Millionaire, One-card, Blackjack and Poker. This time around, the four games included are: Speed, Nervous Breakdown, Seven in a Row and Dobon.

The item collection system, which was popular in the previous title, is still in place. In addition to the "Normal Mode" for enjoying the game as usual, a "Round the World Mode" has been added in which players can travel to famous places around the world to collect items.

127425.overview: The Trump Collection allows you to play four card games: Grand Millionaire, One-card, Blackjack and Poker. All of the games have more than 20 unique characters to play against. Players can also participate in card tournaments and win items (household goods) by participating in and winning them. Once you have all the household goods in a room, the stage is cleared and you can move on to the next stage.

200872.overview: Toshio Iwai, creator of the DS title Electroplankton, also developed the digital musical instrument Tenori-on with Yamaha in 2007. Before that, he made and sold a WonderSwan version at a Bandai expo in Japan back in 2000. It's believed only around 120 were sold there, and the cartridge was never released commercially afterward.
